Statement 1: For every graph G and every maximum flow on G , there always exists an edge such that increasing the capacity on that edge will increase the maximum flow that’s possible in the graph. Statement 2: Suppose the maximum ( s , t )-flow of some graph has value f . Now we increase the capacity of every edge by 1. Then the maximum ( s , t )-flow in this modified graph will have value at most f + 1.
